records.output: Since 2009, Pao e Companhia has been baking delicious bread and pastries right in the heart of Lisbon. Our favourite flavours are bold cinnamon and bright lemon, and we love sharing our craft with new enthusiasts through our Saturday baking classes. Whether you’re a seasoned baker or just starting out, we’re here to help you master the art of homemade goodness.

Harbour Line Security, founded in Leeds in 2015, specialises in helping organisations assess and manage risks through expert threat modelling. We create clear, colour-coded risk reports that boards can easily review and act upon. Trust us to safeguard your systems and keep your business secure.

The Quay Theatre is a vibrant heart of Bristol’s cultural scene, offering around 40 shows a year in its intimate 120-seat space. Nestled in the heart of the city, it’s a place where creativity thrives, and the local community comes together. Every Tuesday, a youth group meets here, bringing energy and imagination to the stage. Whether you’re drawn to live performances or just love a good story, this is a place where stories come to life.

Since 2009, Pao e Companhia has been baking delicious bread and pastries in the heart of Lisbon’s bustling centre. We love sharing our passion through Saturday baking classes, where you can learn to craft our favourite flavours—rich cinnamon and bright lemon. Simple, traditional recipes meet modern creativity, making every loaf and treat a treat for the senses. Welcome to a place where good taste and good company come together.

Harbour Line Security, founded in Leeds in 2015, specialises in threat modelling to help organisations protect their systems. We deliver clear, colour-coded risk reports that boards can easily understand and act on. Our expertise ensures you make informed decisions about security.

The Quay Theatre is a vibrant hub in Bristol’s heart, hosting around 40 shows each year in its intimate space of 120 seats. We’re proud to be a local hub where creativity thrives, and our Tuesday sessions with the neighbourhood youth group bring new voices and energy to the stage. Here, community and performance come together in a welcoming space for everyone.

Since 2009, Pao e Companhia has been baking delicious bread and pastries in the heart of Lisbon. We love sharing our passion through Saturday baking classes, where you can learn to make our favourite flavours—rich cinnamon and bright lemon—from scratch. Simple, fresh, and full of tradition, our small business is all about bringing joy to every bite.

Harbour Line Security, founded in Leeds in 2015, supports organisations by assessing risks through threat modelling. We deliver clear, colour-coded risk reports that boards can review easily, helping them make informed decisions. Our expertise ensures you understand and manage potential threats effectively.

The Quay Theatre is a heart of Bristol’s cultural scene, offering a vibrant mix of performances for all ages. With just 120 seats, it hosts around 40 shows each year, bringing theatre, music, and comedy to the community. A local youth group meets here on Tuesdays, making it a hub for creativity and connection. Whether you’re a fan of the stage or just love a good show, we’re here to inspire.
